data.one_liner: Widgets that automatically play entrance animations when mounted or scrolled into view.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated list, grid, sliver, and individual widgets that trigger entrance animations when they become visible on screen. It builds on top of standard Flutter animations using visibility detectors.
use_when: You want staggered animations for items inside a ListView or GridView as they scroll into view.
You need simple entrance animations triggered by widget visibility without complex setup.
avoid_when: You require complex physics-based or gesture-driven custom animations.
You need an entire general-purpose animation engine with timelines and visual editors.
strengths: Simplifies adding entrance animations to lists, grids, and slivers.
Uses standard Flutter animations for high customizability.
Supports re-animating elements when scrolling in opposite directions.
weaknesses: Limited to visibility-triggered entrance and scroll animations.
Relies on external visibility detection which may have edge cases in complex nested scroll views.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive, fluent extension-based API for all types of Flutter animations.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Better suited for playing complex pre-compiled vector animations from After Effects.
